name: Camping 101: Herbalism
summary: In Tirisfal, Eleanor Shackleton sends new herbalists to Faruza in Brill to learn a useful craft. Incense Candles give spellcasters help as they rest at camps in the wild.

sections.title: Flora for the Camp
sections.body: Herbalism gives alchemists their first materials, but travelers also depend on gathered roots and blossoms. Regional master herbalists teach aspiring foragers to prepare Incense Candles. In Tirisfal Glades, Eleanor Shackleton points promising foragers toward Faruza in Brill once they show basic skill.

sections.title: Sustenance for the Mind
sections.body: Long travel wears on spellcasters and spiritualists. Incense Candles release restorative fragrances to lift spirits and soothe tired minds. Gatherers infuse dried plants into the candles, helping healers and mages whose magical reserves falter on the road.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: Herbalists build their skill so a trainer can teach them to make Incense Candles. The candles help spellcasters while they rest in wilderness camps.

faq.q: Who offers this quest in Tirisfal Glades?
faq.answer: Eleanor Shackleton guides herbalists in Tirisfal Glades and points them toward Faruza in Brill.

faq.q: What does an Incense Candle do?
faq.answer: Incense Candles lift spirits and help healers and magic users recover their mental focus while resting in the field.

faq.q: Who teaches the Incense Candle recipe?
aliases: where to turn in camping 101 herbalism
faq.answer: Local herbalism trainers teach the recipe to qualified herbalists. In Tirisfal Glades, Faruza teaches in Brill; Jandi teaches in Orgrimmar, Reyna Stonebranch in Ironforge, and Malorne Bladeleaf in Dolanaar.

faq.q: Can members of other factions and races take this quest?
faq.answer: Yes. Other guides and trainers give herbalists across Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms the same instruction as Eleanor Shackleton and Faruza give travelers in Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: What skill requirement is needed to complete the training?
faq.answer: Herbalists need a skill of twenty before a trainer will teach them the candle recipe.

angles.text: Herbalists can aid traveling groups by making fragrant Incense Candles for their camps, alongside brewing potions and gathering stalks.
As Forsaken travelers from Deathknell and Brill, you can learn from Faruza to make practical use of Tirisfal's withered plants.
As a mage, you value herbalists who make Incense Candles. Their soothing smoke helps restore focus and spirits far from taverns.
